contact.description: Shown on one centred line in this order, e.g. ['City, Country', 'email', 'phone', 'linkedin.com/in/handle', 'github.com/handle']. Emails and URLs become clickable. Location follows the base resume unless the conventions file says otherwise.

paper.description: letter for jobs in the US and Canada, a4 everywhere else. Same as layout.paper.

summary.description: 2-4 sentences, about 40-90 words: the candidate's real title or function, what they do and for whom. Never the posting's title copied.

summary_title.description: Header text for the summary. Default 'Summary'.

sections.description: In order. Experience first for people with 3+ years of work; Education first for students and new graduates.

link.description: Optional URL; makes the org name clickable (projects)

location.description: Printed right of the org. Keep it if the base resume shows it, unless the conventions say to hide it.

dates.description: Mon YYYY – Mon YYYY, or Mon YYYY – Present

bullets.description: One idea per bullet, 1-3 short sentences (references/writing-rules.md)

text.description: A plain line instead of bullets, e.g. for an education entry

skills.description: Grouped tools and technologies: {'Languages': ['Go', 'Python'], ...}, or a list of ready-made lines.

skills_title.description: Header text for the skills block. Default 'Skills'.

skills_after.description: Title of the section the Skills block follows (e.g. 'Experience'). If omitted, Skills comes last.

layout.description: Render settings, kept here so every rebuild uses the same ones. Command-line options override them.

fill.description: Last-resort layout fill; set only after true content has run out
